# Check whether the only players with to par of "+ 1" are Kenneth Ferrie and Geoff Ogilvy
plus_one = df[df['to par'].str.strip() == '+ 1']

# The players with +1 to par
players = set(plus_one['player'].str.strip().str.lower())

# Expected players
expected = {'kenneth ferrie', 'geoff ogilvy'}

# Verify count is 2 and the players match, and that Geoff Ogilvy is from Australia
answer = bool(
    len(plus_one) == 2
    and players == expected
    and plus_one.loc[plus_one['player'].str.strip().str.lower() == 'geoff ogilvy', 'country'].str.strip().str.lower().iloc[0] == 'australia'
)
